subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw land this full Wear conversation and release surface now, land the status-only stage from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803 first, or remain protocol-only for this release train?
rationale: The code can establish a safe phone-proxy boundary, but choosing the initial Wear product scope and adding a new signed release artifact are Android product and release-policy decisions that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve full companion after repairs
options.body: Fix the incomplete RPC task, refresh current-head device proof, retain manual Wear upload, and close the competing staged branch after this path is accepted.

options.title: Land status-only stage first
options.body: Prefer the smaller status bridge as the initial user-visible release and narrow or pause this broader branch until the staged behavior ships.

options.title: Remain protocol-only
options.body: Keep the merged shared contract as groundwork but defer both runtime endpoints and Wear release packaging to a later owner-sponsored change.

recommendation.title: Approve full companion after repairs
recommendation.body: Fix the incomplete RPC task, refresh current-head device proof, retain manual Wear upload, and close the competing staged branch after this path is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly assigns Android app ownership to @obviyus, and the choice governs Android product scope, security exposure, signing, and Play rollout.
